CanonicalPurpose: Govern preservation of canonical meaning from first contact through competent participation.
GovernedObjects: Canonical definitions; participation states; dependency order; interpretation records
RequiredCapabilities: Canonical reconstruction; boundary recognition; dependency recognition; uncertainty preservation
BoundarySummary: Limited to governed entry, interpretation, initiation, and participation within Morning Star.
DependencySummary: Canonical source precedes interpretation; eligibility precedes participation; revision requires propagation.
AuthoritySummary: Authority must arise from explicit constitutional assignment and remains domain and version bounded.
UncertaintySummary: Unknown, disputed, and insufficient-evidence states must remain explicit.

CanonicalPurpose: Govern canonical revision, stewardship continuity, and propagation of approved semantic changes.
GovernedObjects: Revision proposals; approval records; propagation obligations; stewardship assignments
RequiredCapabilities: Revision classification; stewardship verification; propagation assessment; authority validation
BoundarySummary: Limited to governed revision and stewardship operations; entry competence alone is insufficient.
DependencySummary: Approved revision precedes propagation; authority verification precedes canonical modification.
AuthoritySummary: Revision authority requires explicit assignment within the governing version.
UncertaintySummary: Unresolved revision effects and propagation gaps remain declared.

CanonicalPurpose: Govern reconstruction and interpretation of versioned planetary coordinate records.
GovernedObjects: Coordinate records; temporal references; interpretive projections; provenance records
RequiredCapabilities: Coordinate reconstruction; temporal alignment; projection-boundary recognition; provenance verification
BoundarySummary: Distinct from Morning Star semantic-entry and stewardship governance.
DependencySummary: Validated input precedes coordinate construction; coordinate construction precedes interpretation.
AuthoritySummary: Morning Star participation authority does not transfer into planetary-coordinate governance.
UncertaintySummary: Missing precision and unresolved temporal data remain explicit.
